intent: The ancient court's feast gown: wine velvet and ivory under a tall gold crown, a gold-stomached bodice and belt, and a tiered wine bell skirt with gold centre bands and a gold hem, reading from the high camera as a bright gold crown over a narrow wine top and a wide gold-banded bell.
requests: A tapered or conical part (or a sheared box) for the skirt: boxes can only widen in steps, so the bell reads tiered rather than as one smooth cone.
A translucent cloth material for the train and a veil; solid parts read as boards when they hang free.
A gold material that catches the moon: under the mood preset metal never shines, so the gold has to carry all its light in its colour.
